Use case: stylized-concept. ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Mysteries Above, consistent with approved Fool, Door, Sun, Justiciar and Death sets. Full canvas icon only, no atlas, grid, montage or presentation margins. High-quality PIXEL ART, strict 32x32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID enlarged as crisp nearest-neighbor blocks, broad connected clusters and stepped shadows. Essential silhouette reads at 15x15 and 16x16, thick 2-3 logical-pixel shapes, no tiny noisy details; main silhouette about 24 logical pixels. No painterly texture, 3D, smooth gradient or anti-aliasing. Common PLAIN SILVER square bevel frame ON all canvas edges, one logical pixel/3.125 percent canvas width per side so it survives 32px export; pale #AAAAB4 top/left and charcoal #4B4C58 bottom/right, one dark inset, no ornate corners or black outside margins. Nearly black cool-blue interior #0D1218 and dark negative space. ERROR pathway PRIMARY exact #6699A1 (102,153,161), MUTED DUSTY TEAL / blue-green, not Door's bright icy cyan, not green Death, gold or monochrome purple. Deep teal shadows #2A4652, limited pale teal #B8D8D9 highlights and tiny ivory hot points. Main luminous chromatic clusters must remain clearly teal, about two thirds of colored light. Add coherent harmonious accents according to actual ability/material: amber treasures, bronze skin, burgundy leather/heart, lavender dreams/false thoughts, slate steel, small warm fire. No rainbow speckles, excessive bloom or fuzzy glow. No text, letters, digits, writing, readable runes, UI panels, religious crosses, logos or watermark. Do NOT substitute a universal clock, gear, monocle or one generic stealing-hand icon for all powers. Ability determines unique concept and composition.

A large sneaky HAND emerges diagonally from a deep shadow BEHIND a cloaked target's shoulder at upper right, deft fingers lift a small amber purse/gem from a reachable POCKET low center. The thief is only a dark silhouette with a thick dusty teal #6699A1 rim, broad blue-teal fingers and cuff dominate bright area; small bronze/amber valuables, burgundy target cloak. Actual ability vanishes, appears behind target and pickpockets the nearest carried item, unnoticed in darkness. Show a real pickpocket action, not stealing a literal shadow, striking a victim, portal doorway, floating spell orb or generic dagger emblem.
